name: Spectrum & noise
about: Frequencies from the microphone and noise level in dB
micDenied: No microphone access. It can be allowed in the phone settings.
clip: The microphone is maxed out — it can’t measure louder
approx: Approximate: phone microphones aren’t calibrated. For exact values set a correction in settings against a reference meter or calibrator (94 dB).
set.weight.A: A — how the ear hears at normal loudness. The standard for noise and hearing protection.
set.weight.C: C — almost flat, includes bass. For loud music and peaks.
set.calHint: Place the phone next to a reference meter (or fit a 94 dB calibrator) and adjust the correction in 0.5 dB steps until the readings match.
privacy: Sound is processed on the device only and never recorded. Time in this module isn’t counted in statistics.
